_⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🔴 Critical_

**Validate Collect & Win vial variant before spawning**

`collectAndWinVial.assetVariants[CollectAndWinLocal.GetCurrentColorIndex()]` assumes the array is present and long enough. If the ScriptableObject hasn’t been wired with all five variants yet, we’ll throw a `NullReferenceException` / `IndexOutOfRangeException` while loading the level, blocking gameplay. Please guard the lookup and fall back to the base asset (or skip spawning) when the requested variant is missing.
